prohibited_inference: GAO contract continuation does not prove continued deployment of the same AI programme.
FEMA programme retirement does not prove a supplier penalty or breach.
Feedback without written record cannot certify contractor corrective action.
An unenforceable testing obligation cannot be counted as an actual vendor test.
Preproduction retirement cannot be called a postdeployment remediation.
Follow-on contract improvements are not sanctions under the original contract.
Rejecting a proposed license price is not realized procurement spending.
Software update deployment does not establish improved model accuracy.
Data retention remediation is not AI model remediation.
Routine KPI reporting cannot establish independent verification of every KPI.
Supplier review frequency does not identify a shipped model release.
98.7% screening reduction is a contemporary processing ratio, not vendor-remediation effect.
PHU documentation-time outcomes are not vendor-accountability causal effects.
Buyer-authored template updates cannot be recoded as supplier fixes.
Neither 9 programme families nor 28 event rows are a systematic evidence prevalence sample.
